# Zoom overlay display synchronization (2026-01-13 11:51Z)

_**User**_

right now, when the user zooms in/out there is a "zoom closer" info overlay after a certain zoom level and at some point the already cached areas are shown as a colored-boxes-overlay on the map.

Right now the boxes overlay is shown at a higher zoom level (zoomed out) than the zoom-in overlay. 

This needs to be adjusted, the switch from showing the overlay should happen at the time of showing the zoom-in-overlay

---

_**Agent (model default, mode Agent)**_


Searching for where the zoom-in overlay and the cached-area boxes overlay are controlled.

        "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * MapHelpers.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.\n */\n\nimport MapKit\nimport SwiftUI\nimport CoreLocation\n\n// Helper function for MapStyle\n@available(iOS 17.0, *)\nfunc mapStyleFromSettings(_ mapType: Int) -&gt; MapStyle {\n    switch mapType {\n    case 2:\n        return .hybrid(elevation: .automatic)\n    case 3:\n        return .imagery(elevation: .automatic)\n    default:\n        return .standard(elevation: .automatic)\n    }\n}\n\n// Helper function for zoom level (in km)\nfunc spanForZoomLevel(_ zoomLevel: Int) -&gt; MKCoordinateSpan {\n    // 1° latitude ≈ 111 km\n    let km = Double(zoomLevel)\n    let delta = km / 111.0\n    return MKCoordinateSpan(latitudeDelta: delta, longitudeDelta: delta)\n}\n\n// Helper function to calculate current zoom level from span\nfunc currentZoomLevelFromSpan(_ span: MKCoordinateSpan) -&gt; Int {\n    // Average of latitude and longitude delta\n    let avgDelta = (span.latitudeDelta + span.longitudeDelta) / 2.0\n    // Convert back to km: 1° ≈ 111 km\n    let km = avgDelta * 111.0\n    return Int(round(km))\n}\n\n/// Returns a relative time string for a date (e.g. \"2 minutes ago\" or \"now\")\nfunc relativeTimeString(\n    from date: Date?,\n    to now: Date = Date(),\n    unitsStyle: RelativeDateTimeFormatter.UnitsStyle = .full,\n    timeConsideredNow: TimeInterval = 10\n) -&gt; String {\n    guard let date = date else { return \"–\" }",

        "contents": "    private func overlay(for device: WidgetDeviceData, family: WidgetFamily) -&gt; some View {\n        let locality = formattedLocality(for: device)\n        let distance = formattedDistance(to: device, from: entry.ownDevice)\n        let lastUpdate = formattedUpdateTimestamp(for: device.timestamp)\n\n        let primaryComponents = [device.name, locality, distance].filter { !$0.isEmpty }\n        let primaryLine = primaryComponents.joined(separator: \" • \")\n        let (primaryFont, secondaryFont, spacing, padding) = overlayMetrics(for: family)\n\n        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: spacing) {\n            Text(primaryLine)\n                .font(primaryFont)\n                .lineLimit(1)\n                .minimumScaleFactor(0.6)\n                .shadow(radius: 2)\n            Text(lastUpdate)\n                .font(secondaryFont)\n                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)\n                .lineLimit(1)\n                .minimumScaleFactor(0.6)\n        }\n        .foregroundColor(.primary)\n        .padding(.vertical, padding)\n        .padding(.horizontal, padding + 2)\n        .background(\n            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10)\n                .fill(Color(.systemBackground).opacity(family == .systemMedium ? 0.7 : 0.4))\n        )\n    }\n\n    private func overlayMetrics(for family: WidgetFamily) -&gt; (Font, Font, CGFloat, CGFloat) {\n        switch family {\n        case .systemMedium:\n            return (.subheadline.weight(.semibold), .caption2, 2, 7)\n        case .systemLarge:\n            return (.headline, .subheadline, 3, 12)\n        default:\n            return (.subheadline.weight(.semibold), .caption, 2, 8)\n        }\n    }\n\n    private var overlayWidthFactor: CGFloat {\n        switch family {\n        case .systemMedium: return 0.9\n        case .systemLarge: return 0.92\n        default: return 0.9\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func formattedLocality(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -&gt; String {\n        let locality = device.locality ??         "contents": "        return false\n    }\n}\n\nstruct DeviceLocationMapWidgetEntryView: View {\n    let entry: DeviceMapEntry\n    @Environment(\\.colorScheme) private var colorScheme\n    @Environment(\\.widgetFamily) private var family\n\n    var body: some View {\n        ZStack {\n            if let device = entry.device {\n                GeometryReader { geo in\n                    ZStack(alignment: .topLeading) {\n                        snapshotLayer(for: device)\n                            .frame(width: geo.size.width, height: geo.size.height)\n                            .clipped()\n                        if family != .accessoryRectangular {\n                            topFadeOverlay\n                            overlay(for: device, family: family)\n                                .padding(.top, overlayTopPadding)\n                                .frame(maxWidth: geo.size.width * overlayWidthFactor, alignment: .topLeading)\n                                .padding(.horizontal, overlayHorizontalPadding)\n                        }\n                    }\n                    .ignoresSafeArea() // fill widget content area\n                }\n                .widgetURL(URL(string: \"miataru://\\(device.id)\"))\n            } else {\n                Color.gray.opacity(0.3)\n                    .overlay(\n                        Text(NSLocalizedString(\"widget_no_device_selected\", comment: \"Shown when no device is available for the widget\"))\n                            .font(.caption)\n                            .padding(8),\n                        alignment: .bottomLeading\n                    )\n            }\n        }\n        .containerBackground(for: .widget) {\n            ContainerRelativeShape()\n                .fill(Color(.systemBackground))\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func snapshotLayer(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -&gt; some View {\n        let referenceTimestamp = min(device.timestamp, Date())",

        "contents": "    private func resetZoomToSettings() {\n        isAutoCenteringEnabled = true\n        let span = spanForZoomLevel(settings.mapZoomLevel)\n        let coordinate = bestAvailableLocation\n        if #available(iOS 17.0, *) {\n            let newRegion = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: span)\n            // iPad-specific: Enhanced zoom reset animation\n            beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: 1.0)\n            withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 1.0)) {\n                cameraPosition = .region(newRegion)\n                currentMapSpan = span\n            }\n        } else {\n            // iPad-specific: Enhanced zoom reset animation\n            beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: 1.0)\n            withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 1.0)) {\n                region = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: span)\n            }\n        }\n\n    }\n}\n\n// MARK: - Visible devices calculation (iOS 17+)\nextension iPad_DeviceMapView {\n    private func updateVisibleDeviceCount(with region: MKCoordinateRegion?) {\n        guard let region = region else {\n            visibleDeviceCount = 0\n            return\n        }\n        var count = 0\n        // Main device\n        if let coord = animatedDeviceLocation, isCoordinate(coord, inside: region) {\n            count += 1\n        }\n        // Other devices shown on the map (when inside the viewport)\n        let others = deviceStore.devices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\n        for other in others {\n            if let cached = cache.getLocation(for: other.DeviceID) {\n                let coord = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)\n                if isCoordinate(coord, inside: region) {\n                    count += 1\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        visibleDeviceCount = count\n    }\n}\n\n#Preview {\n    let mockDevice = KnownDevice(name: \"Test Device\", deviceID: \"0C7B98BD-F10F-40BC-AFFE-54484493EB25\", color: .red)",

        "contents": "    private func overlay(for device: WidgetDeviceData, family: WidgetFamily) -&gt; some View {\n        let locality = formattedLocality(for: device)\n        let distance = formattedDistance(to: device, from: entry.ownDevice)\n        let lastUpdate = formattedUpdateTimestamp(for: device.timestamp)\n\n        let primaryComponents = [device.name, locality, distance].filter { !$0.isEmpty }\n        let primaryLine = primaryComponents.joined(separator: \" • \")\n        let (primaryFont, secondaryFont, spacing, padding) = overlayMetrics(for: family)\n\n        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: spacing) {\n            Text(primaryLine)\n                .font(primaryFont)\n                .lineLimit(1)\n                .minimumScaleFactor(0.6)\n                .shadow(radius: 2)\n            Text(lastUpdate)\n                .font(secondaryFont)\n                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)\n                .lineLimit(1)\n                .minimumScaleFactor(0.6)\n        }\n        .foregroundColor(.primary)\n        .padding(.vertical, padding)\n        .padding(.horizontal, padding + 2)\n        .background(\n            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10)\n                .fill(Color(.systemBackground).opacity(family == .systemMedium ? 0.7 : 0.4))\n        )\n    }\n\n    private func overlayMetrics(for family: WidgetFamily) -&gt; (Font, Font, CGFloat, CGFloat) {\n        switch family {\n        case .systemMedium:\n            return (.subheadline.weight(.semibold), .caption2, 2, 7)\n        case .systemLarge:\n            return (.headline, .subheadline, 3, 12)\n        default:\n            return (.subheadline.weight(.semibold), .caption, 2, 8)\n        }\n    }\n\n    private var overlayWidthFactor: CGFloat {\n        switch family {\n        case .systemMedium: return 0.9\n        case .systemLarge: return 0.92\n        default: return 0.9\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func formattedLocality(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -&gt; String {\n        let locality = device.locality ?? MKCircle {\n                let renderer = MKCircleRenderer(circle: circle)\n                let deviceColor = parent.device.DeviceColor ?? UIColor.blue\n                renderer.fillColor = deviceColor.withAlphaComponent(0.2)\n                renderer.strokeColor = deviceColor\n                renderer.lineWidth = 1\n                return renderer\n            }\n            return MKOverlayRenderer(overlay: overlay)\n        }\n        \n        func mapView(_ mapView: MKMapView, viewFor annotation: MKAnnotation) -&gt; MKAnnotationView? {\n            if annotation is MKUserLocation {\n                return nil\n            }\n            \n            let identifier = \"DeviceAnnotation\"\n            var annotationView = mapView.dequeueReusableAnnotationView(withIdentifier: identifier)\n            \n            if annotationView == nil {\n                annotationView = MKAnnotationView(annotation: annotation, reuseIdentifier: identifier)\n                annotationView?.canShowCallout = true\n            } else {\n                annotationView?.annotation = annotation\n            }\n            \n            // iPad-specific: Enhanced marker appearance\n            let deviceColor = parent.device.DeviceColor ??         "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * MapHelpers.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.\n */\n\nimport MapKit\nimport SwiftUI\nimport CoreLocation\n\n// Helper function for MapStyle\n@available(iOS 17.0, *)\nfunc mapStyleFromSettings(_ mapType: Int) -&gt; MapStyle {\n    switch mapType {\n    case 2:\n        return .hybrid(elevation: .automatic)\n    case 3:\n        return .imagery(elevation: .automatic)\n    default:\n        return .standard(elevation: .automatic)\n    }\n}\n\n// Helper function for zoom level (in km)\nfunc spanForZoomLevel(_ zoomLevel: Int) -&gt; MKCoordinateSpan {\n    // 1° latitude ≈ 111 km\n    let km = Double(zoomLevel)\n    let delta = km / 111.0\n    return MKCoordinateSpan(latitudeDelta: delta, longitudeDelta: delta)\n}\n\n// Helper function to calculate current zoom level from span\nfunc currentZoomLevelFromSpan(_ span: MKCoordinateSpan) -&gt; Int {\n    // Average of latitude and longitude delta\n    let avgDelta = (span.latitudeDelta + span.longitudeDelta) / 2.0\n    // Convert back to km: 1° ≈ 111 km\n    let km = avgDelta * 111.0\n    return Int(round(km))\n}\n\n/// Returns a relative time string for a date (e.g. \"2 minutes ago\" or \"now\")\nfunc relativeTimeString(\n    from date: Date?,\n    to now: Date = Date(),\n    unitsStyle: RelativeDateTimeFormatter.UnitsStyle = .full,\n    timeConsideredNow: TimeInterval = 10\n) -&gt; String {\n    guard let date = date else { return \"–\" }",

        "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * ErrorOverlay.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.\n */\n\nimport SwiftUI\nimport Combine\n\nstruct ErrorOverlay: View {\n    let message: String\n    let visible: Bool\n\n    var body: some View {\n        if visible {\n            VStack {\n                Spacer()\n                HStack {\n                    Spacer()\n                    Text(message)\n                        .padding(16)\n                        .background(Color.red.opacity(0.85))\n                        .foregroundColor(.white)\n                        .cornerRadius(12)\n                        .shadow(radius: 10)\n                        .multilineTextAlignment(.center)\n                    Spacer()\n                }\n                Spacer()\n            }\n            .transition(.scale.combined(with: .opacity))\n            .animation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.3), value: visible)\n            .zIndex(1)\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nclass ErrorOverlayManager: ObservableObject {\n    @Published var message: String = \"\"\n    @Published var visible: Bool = false\n\n    private var hideCancellable: AnyCancellable?\n\n    func show(message: String, duration: TimeInterval = 3.0) {\n        self.message = message\n        withAnimation {\n            self.visible = true\n        }\n        hideCancellable?.cancel()\n        hideCancellable = Just(())\n            .delay(for: .seconds(duration), scheduler: DispatchQueue.main)\n            .sink { [weak self] _ in\n                withAnimation {\n                    self?.visible = false\n                }\n            }\n    }\n}\n\n#Preview {\n    ErrorOverlay(message: \"This is an example error message!\", visible: true)\n        .background(Color.gray.opacity(0.2))\n        .edgesIgnoringSafeArea(.all)\n}",

        "contents": "    private func resetZoomToSettings() {\n        isAutoCenteringEnabled = true\n        let span = spanForZoomLevel(settings.mapZoomLevel)\n        let coordinate = bestAvailableLocation\n        if #available(iOS 17.0, *) {\n            let newRegion = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: span)\n            // iPad-specific: Enhanced zoom reset animation\n            beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: 1.0)\n            withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 1.0)) {\n                cameraPosition = .region(newRegion)\n                currentMapSpan = span\n            }\n        } else {\n            // iPad-specific: Enhanced zoom reset animation\n            beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: 1.0)\n            withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 1.0)) {\n                region = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: span)\n            }\n        }\n\n    }\n}\n\n// MARK: - Visible devices calculation (iOS 17+)\nextension iPad_DeviceMapView {\n    private func updateVisibleDeviceCount(with region: MKCoordinateRegion?) {\n        guard let region = region else {\n            visibleDeviceCount = 0\n            return\n        }\n        var count = 0\n        // Main device\n        if let coord = animatedDeviceLocation, isCoordinate(coord, inside: region) {\n            count += 1\n        }\n        // Other devices shown on the map (when inside the viewport)\n        let others = deviceStore.devices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\n        for other in others {\n            if let cached = cache.getLocation(for: other.DeviceID) {\n                let coord = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)\n                if isCoordinate(coord, inside: region) {\n                    count += 1\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        visibleDeviceCount = count\n    }\n}\n\n#Preview {\n    let mockDevice = KnownDevice(name: \"Test Device\", deviceID: \"0C7B98BD-F10F-40BC-AFFE-54484493EB25\", color: .red)",

        "contents": "    private func resetZoomToSettings() {\n        isAutoCenteringEnabled = true\n        let span = spanForZoomLevel(settings.mapZoomLevel)\n        let coordinate = bestAvailableLocation\n        if #available(iOS 17.0, *) {\n            let newRegion = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: span)\n            // iPad-specific: Enhanced zoom reset animation\n            beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: 1.0)\n            withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 1.0)) {\n                cameraPosition = .region(newRegion)\n                currentMapSpan = span\n            }\n        } else {\n            // iPad-specific: Enhanced zoom reset animation\n            beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: 1.0)\n            withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 1.0)) {\n                region = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: span)\n            }\n        }\n\n    }\n}\n\n// MARK: - Visible devices calculation (iOS 17+)\nextension iPad_DeviceMapView {\n    private func updateVisibleDeviceCount(with region: MKCoordinateRegion?) {\n        guard let region = region else {\n            visibleDeviceCount = 0\n            return\n        }\n        var count = 0\n        // Main device\n        if let coord = animatedDeviceLocation, isCoordinate(coord, inside: region) {\n            count += 1\n        }\n        // Other devices shown on the map (when inside the viewport)\n        let others = deviceStore.devices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\n        for other in others {\n            if let cached = cache.getLocation(for: other.DeviceID) {\n                let coord = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)\n                if isCoordinate(coord, inside: region) {\n                    count += 1\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        visibleDeviceCount = count\n    }\n}\n\n#Preview {\n    let mockDevice = KnownDevice(name: \"Test Device\", deviceID: \"0C7B98BD-F10F-40BC-AFFE-54484493EB25\", color: .red)",

           Picker(\"map_update_interval\", selection: $settings.mapUpdateInterval) {\n                        Text(\"5s\").tag(5)\n                        Text(\"10s\").tag(10)\n                        Text(\"15s\").tag(15)\n                        Text(\"30s\").tag(30)\n                        Text(\"60s\").tag(60)\n                    }\n                    Text(NSLocalizedString(\"explanation_map_update_interval\", comment: \"Explanation for map update interval picker\"))\n                        .font(.caption)\n                        .foregroundColor(.secondary)\n                    Picker(\"map_zoom_level\", selection: $settings.mapZoomLevel) {\n                        Text(\"1km\").tag(1)\n         "contents": "    private func resetZoomToSettings() {\n        isAutoCenteringEnabled = true\n        let span = spanForZoomLevel(settings.mapZoomLevel)\n        let coordinate = bestAvailableLocation\n        if #available(iOS 17.0, *) {\n            let newRegion = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: span)\n            // iPad-specific: Enhanced zoom reset animation\n            beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: 1.0)\n            withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 1.0)) {\n                cameraPosition = .region(newRegion)\n                currentMapSpan = span\n            }\n        } else {\n            // iPad-specific: Enhanced zoom reset animation\n            beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: 1.0)\n            withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 1.0)) {\n                region = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: span)\n            }\n        }\n\n    }\n}\n\n// MARK: - Visible devices calculation (iOS 17+)\nextension iPad_DeviceMapView {\n    private func updateVisibleDeviceCount(with region: MKCoordinateRegion?) {\n        guard let region = region else {\n            visibleDeviceCount = 0\n            return\n        }\n        var count = 0\n        // Main device\n        if let coord = animatedDeviceLocation, isCoordinate(coord, inside: region) {\n            count += 1\n        }\n        // Other devices shown on the map (when inside the viewport)\n        let others = deviceStore.devices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\n        for other in others {\n            if let cached = cache.getLocation(for: other.DeviceID) {\n                let coord = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)\n                if isCoordinate(coord, inside: region) {\n                    count += 1\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        visibleDeviceCount = count\n    }\n}\n\n#Preview {\n    let mockDevice = KnownDevice(name: \"Test Device\", deviceID: \"0C7B98BD-F10F-40BC-AFFE-54484493EB25\", color: .red)",

        "contents": "        )\n    }\n\n    private static func render(snapshot: MKMapSnapshotter.Snapshot, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation, size: CGSize, markerImage: UIImage) -&gt; UIImage {\n        let point = snapshot.point(for: coordinate)\n\n        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: size)\n        return renderer.image { context in\n            snapshot.image.draw(in: CGRect(origin: .zero, size: size))\n\n            // Draw marker\n            let markerSize = markerImage.size\n            let markerOrigin = CGPoint(\n                x: point.x - markerSize.width / 2,\n                y: point.y - markerSize.height\n            )\n            markerImage.draw(in: CGRect(origin: markerOrigin, size: markerSize))\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static func markerImage(for device: KnownDevice) async -&gt; UIImage {\n        await MainActor.run {\n            let marker = MiataruMapMarker(\n                color: Color(device.DeviceColor ?? UIColor.systemBlue),\n                height: 44,\n                cacheEnabled: false,\n                renderPadding: 10\n            )\n            let renderer = ImageRenderer(content: marker)\n            renderer.scale = UIScreen.main.scale\n            renderer.isOpaque = false\n            return renderer.uiImage ?? NSColor analog\n#endif\n    }\n}\n\n// Zusatz-Utilities für Cache-Key und Bild-Cache\nextension Color {\n    /// Stabile RGBA-Repräsentation für Cache-Keys\n    func rgbaKey() -&gt; String {\n#if canImport(UIKit)\n        let uiColor = UIColor(self)\n        var r: CGFloat = 0, g: CGFloat = 0, b: CGFloat = 0, a: CGFloat = 0\n        uiColor.getRed(&amp;r, green: &amp;g, blue: &amp;b, alpha: &amp;a)\n        return String(format: \"r%.3fg%.3fb%.3fa%.3f\", r, g, b, a)\n#elseif canImport(AppKit)\n        return String(describing: self)\n#else\n        return String(describing: self)\n#endif\n    }\n}\n\nfinal class MiataruMapMarkerImageCache {\n    static let shared = MiataruMapMarkerImageCache()\n    private let cache = NSCache&lt;NSString, PlatformImage&gt;()\n    private init() {\n        cache.countLimit = 256\n    }\n    func image(for key: String) -&gt; PlatformImage? {\n        cache.object(forKey: key as NSString)\n    }\n    func set(_ image: PlatformImage, for key: String, cost: Int = 0) {\n        cache.setObject(image, forKey: key as NSString, cost: cost)\n    }\n}\n\nstruct MiataruMapMarker: View {\n    @Environment(\\.colorScheme) private var colorScheme",

        "contents": "        return false\n    }\n}\n\nstruct DeviceLocationMapWidgetEntryView: View {\n    let entry: DeviceMapEntry\n    @Environment(\\.colorScheme) private var colorScheme\n    @Environment(\\.widgetFamily) private var family\n\n    var body: some View {\n        ZStack {\n            if let device = entry.device {\n                GeometryReader { geo in\n                    ZStack(alignment: .topLeading) {\n                        snapshotLayer(for: device)\n                            .frame(width: geo.size.width, height: geo.size.height)\n                            .clipped()\n                        if family != .accessoryRectangular {\n                            topFadeOverlay\n                            overlay(for: device, family: family)\n                                .padding(.top, overlayTopPadding)\n                                .frame(maxWidth: geo.size.width * overlayWidthFactor, alignment: .topLeading)\n                                .padding(.horizontal, overlayHorizontalPadding)\n                        }\n                    }\n                    .ignoresSafeArea() // fill widget content area\n                }\n                .widgetURL(URL(string: \"miataru://\\(device.id)\"))\n            } else {\n                Color.gray.opacity(0.3)\n                    .overlay(\n                        Text(NSLocalizedString(\"widget_no_device_selected\", comment: \"Shown when no device is available for the widget\"))\n                            .font(.caption)\n                            .padding(8),\n                        alignment: .bottomLeading\n                    )\n            }\n        }\n        .containerBackground(for: .widget) {\n            ContainerRelativeShape()\n                .fill(Color(.systemBackground))\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func snapshotLayer(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -&gt; some View {\n        let referenceTimestamp = min(device.timestamp, Date())",

MKCircle {\n                let renderer = MKCircleRenderer(circle: circle)\n                let deviceColor = parent.device.DeviceColor ?? UIColor.blue\n                renderer.fillColor = deviceColor.withAlphaComponent(0.2)\n                renderer.strokeColor = deviceColor\n                renderer.lineWidth = 1\n                return renderer\n            }\n            return MKOverlayRenderer(overlay: overlay)\n        }\n        \n        func mapView(_ mapView: MKMapView, viewFor annotation: MKAnnotation) -&gt; MKAnnotationView? {\n            if annotation is MKUserLocation {\n                return nil\n            }\n            \n            let identifier = \"DeviceAnnotation\"\n            var annotationView = mapView.dequeueReusableAnnotationView(withIdentifier: identifier)\n            \n            if annotationView == nil {\n                annotationView = MKAnnotationView(annotation: annotation, reuseIdentifier: identifier)\n                annotationView?.canShowCallout = true\n            } else {\n                annotationView?.annotation = annotation\n            }\n            \n            // iPad-specific: Enhanced marker appearance\n            let deviceColor = parent.device.DeviceColor ?? UIColor.blue\n            annotationView?.image = createDeviceMarkerImage(color: deviceColor)\n            annotationView?.frame = CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 30, height: 30)\n            \n            return annotationView\n        }\n        \n        private func createDeviceMarkerImage(color: UIColor) -&gt; UIImage? {\n            let size = CGSize(width: 30, height: 30)",

        "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * MiataruMapMarker.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.\n */\n\nimport SwiftUI\n#if canImport(UIKit)\nimport UIKit\n#elseif canImport(AppKit)\nimport AppKit\n#endif\n\n// Hilfs-Extension für Kontrastbestimmung\nextension Color {\n    /// Returns true if the color is considered 'light' (für Kontrast)\n    func isLight(threshold: Float = 0.6) -&gt; Bool {\n#if canImport(UIKit)\n        let uiColor = UIColor(self)\n        var r: CGFloat = 0, g: CGFloat = 0, b: CGFloat = 0, a: CGFloat = 0\n        uiColor.getRed(&amp;r, green: &amp;g, blue: &amp;b, alpha: &amp;a)\n        let luminance = 0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b\n        return Float(luminance) &gt; threshold\n#else\n        return false // macOS: ggf. NSColor analog\n#endif\n    }\n}\n\n// Zusatz-Utilities für Cache-Key und Bild-Cache\nextension Color {\n    /// Stabile RGBA-Repräsentation für Cache-Keys\n    func rgbaKey() -&gt; String {\n#if canImport(UIKit)\n        let uiColor = UIColor(self)\n        var r: CGFloat = 0, g: CGFloat = 0, b: CGFloat = 0, a: CGFloat = 0\n        uiColor.getRed(&amp;r, green: &amp;g, blue: &amp;b, alpha: &amp;a)\n        return String(format: \"r%.3fg%.3fb%.3fa%.3f\", r, g, b, a)\n#elseif canImport(AppKit)\n        return String(describing: self)\n#else\n        return String(describing: self)\n#endif\n    }\n}\n\nfinal class MiataruMapMarkerImageCache {\n    static let shared = MiataruMapMarkerImageCache()\n    private let cache = NSCache&lt;NSString, PlatformImage&gt;()\n    private init() {\n        cache.countLimit = 256\n    }\n    func image(for key: String) -&gt; PlatformImage? {\n        cache.object(forKey: key as NSString)\n    }\n    func set(_ image: PlatformImage, for key: String, cost: Int = 0) {\n        cache.setObject(image, forKey: key as NSString, cost: cost)\n    }\n}\n\nstruct MiataruMapMarker: View {\n    @Environment(\\.colorScheme) private var colorScheme",

        "contents": "    private func resetZoomToSettings() {\n        isAutoCenteringEnabled = true\n        let span = spanForZoomLevel(settings.mapZoomLevel)\n        let coordinate = bestAvailableLocation\n        if #available(iOS 17.0, *) {\n            let newRegion = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: span)\n            // iPad-specific: Enhanced zoom reset animation\n            beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: 1.0)\n            withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 1.0)) {\n                cameraPosition = .region(newRegion)\n                currentMapSpan = span\n            }\n        } else {\n            // iPad-specific: Enhanced zoom reset animation\n            beginProgrammaticCameraAnimation(duration: 1.0)\n            withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 1.0)) {\n                region = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: span)\n            }\n        }\n\n    }\n}\n\n// MARK: - Visible devices calculation (iOS 17+)\nextension iPad_DeviceMapView {\n    private func updateVisibleDeviceCount(with region: MKCoordinateRegion?) {\n        guard let region = region else {\n            visibleDeviceCount = 0\n            return\n        }\n        var count = 0\n        // Main device\n        if let coord = animatedDeviceLocation, isCoordinate(coord, inside: region) {\n            count += 1\n        }\n        // Other devices shown on the map (when inside the viewport)\n        let others = deviceStore.devices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\n        for other in others {\n            if let cached = cache.getLocation(for: other.DeviceID) {\n                let coord = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)\n                if isCoordinate(coord, inside: region) {\n                    count += 1\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        visibleDeviceCount = count\n    }\n}\n\n#Preview {\n    let mockDevice = KnownDevice(name: \"Test Device\", deviceID: \"0C7B98BD-F10F-40BC-AFFE-54484493EB25\", color: .red)",

        "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * ErrorOverlay.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.\n */\n\nimport SwiftUI\nimport Combine\n\nstruct ErrorOverlay: View {\n    let message: String\n    let visible: Bool\n\n    var body: some View {\n        if visible {\n            VStack {\n                Spacer()\n                HStack {\n                    Spacer()\n                    Text(message)\n                        .padding(16)\n                        .background(Color.red.opacity(0.85))\n                        .foregroundColor(.white)\n                        .cornerRadius(12)\n                        .shadow(radius: 10)\n                        .multilineTextAlignment(.center)\n                    Spacer()\n                }\n                Spacer()\n            }\n            .transition(.scale.combined(with: .opacity))\n            .animation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.3), value: visible)\n            .zIndex(1)\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nclass ErrorOverlayManager: ObservableObject {\n    @Published var message: String = \"\"\n    @Published var visible: Bool = false\n\n    private var hideCancellable: AnyCancellable?\n\n    func show(message: String, duration: TimeInterval = 3.0) {\n        self.message = message\n        withAnimation {\n            self.visible = true\n        }\n        hideCancellable?.cancel()\n        hideCancellable = Just(())\n            .delay(for: .seconds(duration), scheduler: DispatchQueue.main)\n            .sink { [weak self] _ in\n                withAnimation {\n                    self?.visible = false\n                }\n            }\n    }\n}\n\n#Preview {\n    ErrorOverlay(message: \"This is an example error message!\", visible: true)\n        .background(Color.gray.opacity(0.2))\n        .edgesIgnoringSafeArea(.all)\n}",

        "contents": "    private func regionThatFits(user: CLLocationCoordinate2D, dest: CLLocationCoordinate2D) -&gt; MKCoordinateRegion {\n        // Compute a region that fits both points with padding and minimum span to avoid over-zooming\n        let center = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: (user.latitude + dest.latitude) / 2,\n                                            longitude: (user.longitude + dest.longitude) / 2)\n        let baseLat = abs(user.latitude - dest.latitude)\n        let baseLon = abs(user.longitude - dest.longitude)\n        let paddedLat = max(baseLat * fitPaddingMultiplier, fitMinimumSpan.latitudeDelta)\n        let paddedLon = max(baseLon * fitPaddingMultiplier, fitMinimumSpan.longitudeDelta)\n        let span = MKCoordinateSpan(latitudeDelta: paddedLat, longitudeDelta: paddedLon)\n        return MKCoordinateRegion(center: center, span: span)\n    }\n\n    private func calculateRoute(ignoreCache: Bool = false) {\n        // Calculate a new route between user and selected device.",

        "contents": "    private func stopPlayback() {\n        playbackTask?.cancel()\n        playbackTask = nil\n        isPlaying = false\n        isPlaybackStepping = false\n        playbackLockedSpan = nil\n    }\n\n    @MainActor\n    private func focusOnEntry(_ entry: MiataruLocationData, within entries: [MiataruLocationData]) {\n        let coordinate = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: entry.Latitude, longitude: entry.Longitude)\n        if let lockedSpan = playbackLockedSpan, isPlaying {\n            let region = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: lockedSpan)\n            setCameraRegion(region, animated: true)\n            return\n        }\n\n        guard let index = entries.firstIndex(where: { $0.Timestamp == entry.Timestamp &amp;&amp; $0.Latitude == entry.Latitude &amp;&amp; $0.Longitude == entry.Longitude }) else {\n            updateRegion(animated: true, using: [entry], useDefaultZoom: true)\n            return\n        }\n        let lowerBound = max(0, index - 1)\n        let upperBound = min(entries.count - 1, index + 1)\n        let contextEntries = Array(entries[lowerBound...upperBound])\n        updateRegion(animated: true, using: contextEntries, useDefaultZoom: false)\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * MapHelpers.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.\n */\n\nimport MapKit\nimport SwiftUI\nimport CoreLocation\n\n// Helper function for MapStyle\n@available(iOS 17.0, *)\nfunc mapStyleFromSettings(_ mapType: Int) -&gt; MapStyle {\n    switch mapType {\n    case 2:\n        return .hybrid(elevation: .automatic)\n    case 3:\n        return .imagery(elevation: .automatic)\n    default:\n        return .standard(elevation: .automatic)\n    }\n}\n\n// Helper function for zoom level (in km)\nfunc spanForZoomLevel(_ zoomLevel: Int) -&gt; MKCoordinateSpan {\n    // 1° latitude ≈ 111 km\n    let km = Double(zoomLevel)\n    let delta = km / 111.0\n    return MKCoordinateSpan(latitudeDelta: delta, longitudeDelta: delta)\n}\n\n// Helper function to calculate current zoom level from span\nfunc currentZoomLevelFromSpan(_ span: MKCoordinateSpan) -&gt; Int {\n    // Average of latitude and longitude delta\n    let avgDelta = (span.latitudeDelta + span.longitudeDelta) / 2.0\n    // Convert back to km: 1° ≈ 111 km\n    let km = avgDelta * 111.0\n    return Int(round(km))\n}\n\n/// Returns a relative time string for a date (e.g. \"2 minutes ago\" or \"now\")\nfunc relativeTimeString(\n    from date: Date?,\n    to now: Date = Date(),\n    unitsStyle: RelativeDateTimeFormatter.UnitsStyle = .full,\n    timeConsideredNow: TimeInterval = 10\n) -&gt; String {\n    guard let date = date else { return \"–\" }",
